info.title: Gelatin Partner DJ Booking API
info.description: Partner-scoped HTTP API for listing Gelatin DJs, submitting booking requests, handing organizers to Gelatin's hosted booking page, and reading booking status. Pre-release: the contract may change before 1.0.

get.summary: Read approved DJs and advisory availability

parameters.name: partner
parameters.description: Partner slug; the bearer key must be scoped to this same partner.

parameters.name: city
parameters.description: City, with or without its US state: "Atlanta, GA", "Atlanta" and "Atlanta, Georgia" return the same DJs. Use a label from listPartnerCities. Returns DJs whose profile names that city, plus, for a city in the SDK's US_MAJOR_CITIES, DJs whose service radius covers it. Case and surrounding whitespace are ignored. This is the default city rule; Gelatin can set a partner to exact-name matching, which returns only DJs whose profile city is exactly the query text (case and surrounding whitespace still ignored), with no aliases or service radius.

parameters.name: genre
parameters.description: One genre from the DJ's profile. Case, accents, whitespace and punctuation are ignored, so "Deep-House" and "deep house" return the same DJs; there is no synonym list. Use a name from listPartnerGenres. A genre no DJ lists returns an empty page, not an error. Text with no letters or digits is rejected.

parameters.name: date
parameters.description: Calendar date for advisory availability. When omitted, available is false.

parameters.name: budget
parameters.description: Budget bands, comma-separated, each at most once: under_300 (below $300), 300_to_600 ($300 up to but not including $600), 600_to_1000 ($600 up to but not including $1,000), 1000_plus ($1,000 and up). Lower bounds are inclusive, so $300 exactly is in 300_to_600, $600 in 600_to_1000 and $1,000 in 1000_plus. Returns DJs whose real minimum rate is in any listed band, including DJs who keep their rate private; their published_rate_cents stays null and results stay ordered by ID, so a response reveals only band membership. A DJ with no rate on file is in no band. Combines with city and date: every filter must match. An unknown, empty or repeated band, or a repeated budget parameter, is rejected with 400 invalid_query. The SDK exports the bands as BUDGET_BANDS from @gelatinbookings/partner-sdk/budget.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque keyset position bound to the authenticated partner and city, genre, date and budget filters. Eligibility is checked again on every page.

get.description: Requires catalog:read. Only active DJs approved by partner distribution settings, with partner exclusions taking precedence. Only published partner-allowlisted fields; hidden rates stay null. Availability requires a date, payout readiness and no known date conflict; rechecked at each mutation. Unknown or duplicate query parameters are rejected. Responses use Cache-Control: private, no-store.

get.summary: List US states and major cities with this partner's DJ counts

parameters.name: partner
parameters.description: Partner slug; the bearer key must be scoped to this same partner.

200.description: Directory of cities grouped by country and state

get.description: Requires catalog:read. Every US state and DC with its major cities (the SDK's US_MAJOR_CITIES: U.S. Census Bureau Vintage 2024, the 200 most populous places plus each state's most populous), plus any other city a DJ in this partner's catalog names. dj_count is the number of DJs listPartnerDjs returns for that city's label, under the partner's city rule. By default that is DJs whose profile names the city, plus, for a bundled city, DJs whose service radius covers it. A partner on exact-name matching sees each stored city spelling as its own entry, counted by exact name only. It applies the same distribution settings and exclusions. Cities with no DJs stay listed with dj_count 0. No coordinates, radii or DJ identifiers are returned. Cities Gelatin cannot place in a US state are grouped under a country with a null code. Takes no query parameters; any are rejected. Responses use Cache-Control: private, no-store.

post.summary: Ask to be told when a city has DJs (mounted)
post.description: Requires `requests:write` and counts against the partner's write quota. Send it when an organizer picks a city with `dj_count: 0` and asks to be told when DJs are available there. `city` must be the `label` of a bundled US city from listPartnerCities (the SDK's US_MAJOR_CITIES); `consent` must be `true`. Gelatin stores the email lower-cased with the city, its state, the source and the time of the request, once per email, city and partner. The response never contains the email or any other sign-up. Gelatin sends no email from this route. Responses use Cache-Control: private, no-store.

parameters.name: partner
parameters.description: Partner slug; the bearer key must be scoped to this same partner.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Required on every write. A sign-up is already one row per email and city, so a retry with any key lands on the same row.

200.description: `already_subscribed`: this email already asked for this city through this partner. The first consent time is kept.

400.description: `invalid_request`: the body is invalid or over 2 KiB, has unknown fields, the email is not an address of at most 254 characters, the city is not a bundled city label, `consent` is not `true`, or the `Idempotency-Key` header is missing or longer than 255 characters. `invalid_query`: the URL has query parameters. Fields are never echoed.

503.description: `temporarily_unavailable` with `Retry-After: 30`: retry; a repeat lands on the same sign-up.

get.summary: List the genres this partner's DJs list, with DJ counts

parameters.name: partner
parameters.description: Partner slug; the bearer key must be scoped to this same partner.

parameters.name: city
parameters.description: A city label from listPartnerCities. Only DJs listPartnerDjs returns for this city are counted, by the same rule (named city or service radius). Omit for every city.

parameters.name: budget
parameters.description: Same bands and format as listPartnerDjs budget. When set, only DJs in those bands are counted, so each count is what listPartnerDjs returns for that city, budget and genre.

200.description: Genres present among this partner's DJs, busiest first

get.description: Requires catalog:read. The genres listed by the DJs this partner may show (same distribution settings and exclusions as listPartnerDjs), optionally in one city and budget bands. dj_count is the number of DJs listPartnerDjs returns for that city, budget and genre. Spellings that differ only in case, accents, whitespace or punctuation are one genre, named by the spelling most of its DJs use. Only genres with at least one DJ are listed, busiest first, at most 100. No DJ identifiers are returned. Accepts only the city and budget query parameters; others are rejected. Responses use Cache-Control: private, no-store.

post.summary: Create one partner booking with one or more DJ engagements

parameters.name: partner
parameters.description: Partner slug; the bearer key must be scoped to this same partner.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Stable key for one logical write. Same key and body return the original result; a changed body returns 409.

409.description: `conflict`: the idempotency key or an external request was reused with different terms. `dj_unavailable`: a selected DJ cannot take this event; nothing was created and the whole submission rolled back. Offer another DJ or change the schedule, then submit with a new idempotency key. `503 temporarily_unavailable` is reserved for outages.

error.message: A selected DJ is not available for this event.

post.description: One stable partner booking groups independently negotiated and payable DJ engagements. Each DJ requires its own authorization; no combined charge or all-or-nothing acceptance.

parameters.name: partner
parameters.description: Partner slug; the bearer key must be scoped to this same partner.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Stable key for one logical write. Same key and body return the original result; a changed body returns 409.

parameters.name: partner
parameters.description: Partner slug; the bearer key must be scoped to this same partner.

get.description: Requires bookings:read. Mounted. Resolves the event only through the authenticated partner's own external_event_id; an unknown event and another partner's event both return the same 404. Each request reports authorization_required until a signed hold exists on its current offer; requested while the DJ considers a held offer, including acceptance awaiting a signed capture; reauthorization_required when the DJ countered or the offer changed: a counteroffer releases the earlier hold, so the organizer must approve the new total and place a new hold; negotiating is reserved for a counter open while a hold is still valid, which the current flow does not produce; confirmed only after Gelatin records the signed capture; and declined, expired or cancelled when it ends. The actions array is currently always empty: portal links are single-use, so mint one with the portal launch route when the organizer acts rather than on each read. revision stays 0 until event change submission is mounted; use the ETag for change detection. ETag and If-None-Match return 304 with no body. Responses use Cache-Control: private, no-store.

get.summary: List alternates after a DJ passes, an offer expires or a request is lost

parameters.name: partner
parameters.description: Partner slug; the bearer key must be scoped to this same partner.

parameters.name: request_id
parameters.description: A request_id from getEventBookings or submitBookingRequests.

200.description: Who else is open for the lost slot

get.description: Requires bookings:read. Only for a request whose status is declined, expired or cancelled; a live request answers 409 request_active. Returns up to five DJs from this partner's catalog who are available on the event's own calendar date, in its city (from the venue address, else the lost DJ's city; matched by the partner's city rule, as in listPartnerDjs), and who publish a rate within the organizer's last offered DJ fee plus a fifth, or publish none. The lost DJ and every DJ already asked for this event are left out. Ordered by published rate, nearest the budget first; private rates never filter or order. Includes the partner's own event details to prefill a new request. Reading this creates no booking, hold or payment. Unknown and another partner's requests are indistinguishable (404). Takes no query parameters. Responses use Cache-Control: private, no-store.

parameters.name: partner
parameters.description: Partner slug; the bearer key must be scoped to this same partner.

parameters.name: include
parameters.description: Pass pending to add DJs who have the offer and haven't settled it yet, for a TBA slot. Omit for confirmed DJs only.

get.description: Requires bookings:read. Mounted. Who is playing at one of your events, safe to show on a public event page: each DJ's id, name, public profile link and photo, and nothing about price, offers or the organizer. Resolves the event only through the authenticated partner's own external_event_id; an unknown event and another partner's event both return the same 404. By default it lists only DJs whose booking is confirmed (Gelatin recorded the signed capture). include=pending also lists DJs who have the offer and haven't settled it (requested, negotiating or reauthorization_required in getEventBookings) with status pending; a request still waiting for the organizer's first card hold is never listed, because the DJ hasn't seen it. Declined, expired and cancelled bookings are simply absent. A DJ appears once per event, and a DJ removed from your catalog distribution is left out. Link the name to profile_url wherever it is shown. ETag and If-None-Match return 304 with no body. Responses use Cache-Control: private, no-store.

post.summary: Submit one partner booking with one or more DJ requests (mounted)
post.description: Requires `requests:write`. Body at most 64 KiB. `authorization_placement` is `partner_event_flow` when your page takes the first card hold with `POST /payment-sessions`, or `gelatin_portal_handoff` when the organizer pays in Gelatin through a portal launch. Both stay able to use the portal, which is where a DJ's counteroffer is reviewed. `return_url` must use an origin Gelatin registered for the partner.

parameters.name: partner
parameters.description: Partner slug; the bearer key must be scoped to this same partner.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Stable key for one logical write. Same key and body return the original result; a changed body returns 409.

201.description: Created; a same-key retry with the same body returns the original result

400.description: `invalid_request`: the body is not valid JSON, is over 64 KiB, fails the schema (including a `dj_fee_cents` above 100,000,000 or a non-USD currency), uses a return URL outside your registered return origins, or the `Idempotency-Key` header is missing, padded or longer than 255 characters. Field details are never echoed. Fix the request; do not retry it unchanged.

404.description: `not_found`: your partner integration is switched off. Contact Gelatin; retrying will not help.

409.description: Permanent; do not retry unchanged. `dj_unavailable` (with `external_request_id`): that request's DJ is unknown, inactive, already booked, blacked out, excluded from your catalog or not yet payable. Nothing was created and the whole submission rolled back; offer another DJ or change the schedule, then submit with a new idempotency key. `conflict`: the idempotency key was reused with a different body, the `external_booking_id` was already submitted with different terms or belongs to another event or organizer, an `external_request_id` already belongs to another booking or DJ, or the `external_event_id` belongs to another organizer.

error.message: A selected DJ is not available for this event.
This booking request conflicts with an earlier submission.

503.description: `temporarily_unavailable` with `Retry-After: 30`: a Gelatin outage. Retry with the same `Idempotency-Key` and the same body.

post.summary: Create a single-use organizer portal launch for one DJ engagement (mounted)
post.description: Requires `launch:write`. The resource must belong to the same partner, external event and external organizer. The returned URL carries a one-use secret in its fragment and expires after 60 seconds; redirect the organizer immediately and never log it. `return_url` must use a registered return origin.

parameters.name: partner
parameters.description: Partner slug; the bearer key must be scoped to this same partner.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Stable key for one logical write. Same key and body return the original result; a changed body returns 409.

201.description: Created; a same-key retry with the same body returns the original result

400.description: `invalid_request`: the body is invalid or over 2 KiB, has unknown fields, the `return_url` is outside your registered return origins or contains credentials, or the `Idempotency-Key` header is missing, padded or longer than 255 characters.

404.description: `resource_unavailable`: no request or booking with that id belongs to this partner, event and organizer, or it can no longer be opened.

409.description: `idempotency_conflict`: this `Idempotency-Key` was already used for a different launch body. Use a new key for a new launch.

503.description: `temporarily_unavailable` with `Retry-After: 30`: retry with the same `Idempotency-Key` and body; you get the same link back.

post.summary: Start or resume the card hold for an organizer's initial offer on your page (mounted)
post.description: Requires `launch:write`. The request must belong to the same partner, external event and external organizer, and its current offer must be the one the organizer submitted; a DJ's counteroffer returns 409 `portal_required` and is reviewed in Gelatin through a portal launch. Returns an embedded Stripe Checkout for the organizer's browser to mount with Stripe.js (`createEmbeddedCheckoutPage`) using `publishable_key`. The client secret opens only this checkout; send it to that organizer's browser only and never log it. Card details go to Stripe directly. Completing the checkout does not by itself place the hold: read booking status, which changes once Stripe confirms the hold to Gelatin. One open hold exists per offer: any key, and the Gelatin portal, resume the same checkout.

parameters.name: partner
parameters.description: Partner slug; the bearer key must be scoped to this same partner.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Key for this call; a retry with the same key and body returns the same checkout. A fresh key per click is fine: Gelatin resumes the open hold for the offer.

400.description: `invalid_request`: the body is invalid or over 2 KiB, has unknown fields, or the `Idempotency-Key` header is missing, padded or longer than 255 characters.

404.description: `resource_unavailable`: no request with that id belongs to this partner, event and organizer.

409.description: `portal_required`: the current offer is a DJ's counteroffer, or its hold was started on a Stripe-hosted page; create a portal launch. `offer_changed`: the offer changed, was already authorized or has expired; read booking status. `dj_unavailable`: the DJ can no longer take this booking.

503.description: `temporarily_unavailable` with `Retry-After: 30`: retry; you get the same open checkout back.

PartnerBearer.description: Server-side only. Separate scoped sandbox and production keys.

Error.description: Narrow error envelope; no raw provider or personal data

external_request_id.description: Present only on `dj_unavailable`: the partner's `external_request_id` whose DJ cannot take the event. The reason (booked, blacked out, not distributed or not payout-ready) is deliberately not disclosed.

profile_url.description: The DJ's public profile. By default, the co-branded page on the partner's active portal origin, or Gelatin's /djs page when it has none. Gelatin can set a partner to always link to Gelatin's /djs page.

oneOf.description: Verified draw: venue-confirmed head counts over the window, excluding disputed and auto-confirmed ones. Null when the DJ has no verified night; never 0.

genres.description: Up to six genres from the DJ's profile, in the DJ's own order; empty when the DJ lists none. When the catalog was filtered by genre, that genre is first. Added after the first release: clients should treat a missing field as an empty list.

available.description: Advisory only. False without a requested date, payout readiness, or when a known date conflict applies. A true result does not reserve a slot; each paid mutation rechecks eligibility and timing.

label.description: Send as the city query of listPartnerDjs.

dj_count.description: DJs listPartnerDjs returns for this label. Zero is listed, not hidden.

code.description: US state code, or null for cities not placed in a state.
Country code, or null for cities not placed in a country.

email.description: The organizer's email; stored trimmed and lower-cased.

city.description: A bundled city's label from listPartnerCities, such as "Boise, ID".

consent.description: True only after the organizer asked to be told.

source.description: Where the ask came from, such as empty_state. Defaults to partner_api.

name.description: The spelling most of these DJs use. Pass it as genre to listPartnerDjs.

ends_at.description: Must be later than starts_at. The server never invents a DJ engagement duration.

time_zone.description: An IANA timezone accepted by Gelatin, such as America/New_York.

venue_address.description: Optional street address of the venue. Gelatin shows it to the DJ in their invitation, inbox and booking page.

external_booking_id.description: Stable partner booking identity; groups one or more independently payable DJ engagements.

partner_booking_id.description: Gelatin partner booking group ID; not an individual DJ booking or payment ID.

request_id.description: Pass as a portal launch resource of kind `request`.

booking_id.description: Pass as a portal launch resource of kind `booking`.

client_secret.description: Embedded Stripe Checkout client secret for this one hold

publishable_key.description: Gelatin's Stripe publishable key for this environment (`pk_test_` in the sandbox)

total_cents.description: What the organizer authorizes: DJ fee plus Gelatin's service fee and card processing

profile_url.description: The DJ's public profile. By default, the co-branded page on the partner's active portal origin, or Gelatin's /djs page when it has none. Gelatin can set a partner to always link to Gelatin's /djs page.

dj_id.description: The DJ whose request was lost.

date.description: The event's own calendar date in its time zone.

city.description: A listPartnerCities label, or null when there was no city to go on.

budget.description: The organizer's last offered DJ fee.
